description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima the Impostor and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima the Impostor tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
